title: Matches

review.classification: Verified frozen leaf and official CPC3 38998 row 1856 mapping to HS 3605. One real, original, closed retail box of ordinary household safety matches qualifies when its full contents, form and earliest qualifying release are supported. Empty boxes, a loose or independently repacked purchased product, decorative box holders, multipack dispatch or aggregate production statistics have different scopes.
review.primary_evidence: The manufacturer’s product-family comparison identifies the Hushållsask independently of the foundation’s accounting for the marketed household box. Swedish Match’s 2021 environmental reporting uses a box as a production unit. Its aggregated environmental data and nominal numbers printed on boxes do not measure the quantity or environmental inventory of an individual released lot. The producer distinguishes inner and outer packaging board and acknowledges variation in marked count.
review.native_records: Both public native records identify generic Matches classified under 38998, with Mass as their native reference property. Neither specifies the bounded Hushållsask or proves a number-of-completed-boxes reference. Differentiate the study reference, native product identity and measured exchange unit. The original mass-distance property and unit group independently establish t*km and the 0.001 kg*km conversion, while the actual provider, coverage and loading convention still require study evidence.

native_public_reads.use: Generic classification-level matches. The reference product is a specific original filled household retail box and release boundary. Positive identity requires a matching specification and study records.

review.readiness: Verified methodology and product mapping leave actual study lot, initial release, eligible full box identity, variation, real component measurements and quantitative supplier inventory for data collection. Scientific review and independent translation review remain separate.
review.measurement: The reference is one kilogram of intact completed retail boxes, including their functional drawer and sleeve, with separately documented external wrap, carton and pallet tare excluded. Q counts released boxes and W measures their matched mass. Synthetic independent kg audit: unreleased opening 4 plus opaque internal completions 7, first unreleased receipts 3 and a genuine original return 1 equals first release 8, outward 2, documented intact waste 1 and closing 4. Released opening 5 plus that same 8, external released receipts 1 and genuine old returns 2 equals onward dispatch 9, intact disposal 1 and closing 6. W cancels in the combined perimeter. At zero current W, only verified positive original released mass can normalize separate later electricity, packaging or freight service; otherwise the actual original-unit records stay unnormalized. A damaged retained item or unexplained loss has a documented reclassification or separately reported unresolved balance rather than an assumed waste or emission.

sources.role: Controller-reviewed producer FAQ, use only the two accounting observations already extracted here. In the packaging question the producer identifies recycled paperboard for its inner and outer boxes. In the question on quantities per box it acknowledges variation from the marked item count. Require actual lot/tally evidence for an item-count conversion; exclude generic daily production, technical questions and product performance. These statements do not establish a specified retail lot, its packaging mass or its incremental footprint. No need to open other sections.

Manufacturer’s Inside 3, 2006, p. 8, product-family panel. The original photograph distinguishes the Hushållsask household presentation from the smaller Bruksask and other retail formats. Historic product identity only.

Corporate environmental accounting used one matchbox as a unit of production. The sustainability report aggregates energy and footprint across many products. The particular filled retail box and its measured contents count/weight must be verified at the factory first release. A cross-segment average, shipping case, empty matchbox or certified wood does not supply the finished lot. Use solely nonoperational environmental information.
UNSD October 2026 original, CPC3 worksheet row 1856, HS 2022 3605. Classification evidence only; retain the original June 2025 frozen coordinate.

First-party Swedish charitable beneficiary distinguishes the basis of its actual receipts on commercial finished boxes. The Hushållsask household box is a separate line from three small/long presentations, and from other articles. This corroborates the finished household box independently of a generic production claim. Donation figures cannot supply an environmental exchange, finished factory-event count, item count per box or packaging mass. Require the actual Hushållsask SKU, form, date and lot. A closed original box does not by itself imply an individual airtight or tamper-evident seal; distinguish individual box from any multipack.

Independent NEPCon certificate NC-COC-012942 Annex A, p. 2, W16.6. Its specific 2019–2024 validity and requirement for claims on matching sales/shipping documentation prevent a generic certificate becoming a later lot-specific FSC claim or physical wood/box environmental inventory. Product and environmental accounting only.

JRC ILCD Handbook, 2010, General guide, detailed guidance, sections 7.9.2–7.9.3. Supports subdivision and evidenced allocation in the declared attributional modelling case. No product factor or full ILCD conformity is inferred.
